title: Pink's Hilarious Reaction to Her No-Makeup Street Style Photo Will Make You Raise a Glass
text:
Pink Reacts to No-Makeup Paparazzi Photo Criticism 
 E!'s The Golden Life
 Watch the Season 1 Premiere Now! News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop News Photos Videos Shopping Kardashians Couples Influencers Red Carpet Royals TV Scoop Pink's Hilarious Reaction to Her No-Makeup Street Style Photo Will Make You Raise a Glass
 Pink didn't hold back after a candid photo of her walking around New York City without any makeup and a scarf wrapped around her head went viral: "I look HOT." 
 By Gabrielle Chung Oct 28, 2026 2:46 AM | Updated 3 hours ago Tags Pink Beauty Makeup Celebrities E! Insider Link Copied Add E! News to Google Watch : Pink Shares the Emotional Advice She Gave Daughter Willow Ahead of 15th Birthday So what? Pink doesn't need much to be a rockstar.
 The Grammy winner proved just that when a makeup-free photo of her walking around New York City went viral. In the Oct. 26 candid, Pink (real name Alecia Moore ) donned a baggy, purple sweat set and a patterned headscarf as she carried her dog in a beige sling across her chest. 
 "What is everyone talking about? I look HOT, and you can tell that’s what I was going for, too," she wrote in an Oct. 27 Instagram Story. "I woke up and said ‘I am going to be serving LOOKS today.’ And I did that."
 The 47-year-old added in a separate smiling selfie, which showed her in a tank top and thick-rimmed glasses, "I look even better today."
 Indeed, Pink has never let others make her feel less than f--kin' perfect. As she told her and husband Carey Hart 's daughter Willow while accepting the Video Vanguard Award at the 2017 MTV VMAs, "Baby girl, we don't change , we take the gravel and the shell and we make a pearl."
 read Inside Pink's New Life With Her Family in New York City "I said to her, 'Do you see me growing my hair?' She said, 'No, mama,'" Pink shared at the time. "I said, 'Do you see me changing my body?' 'No, mama.' 'Do you see me changing the way I present myself to the world?' 'No, mama.' 'Do you see me selling out arenas all over the world?' 'Yes, Mama.'"
 She added, "We help other people to change so that they can see more kinds of beauty."
 And over the years, Pink has continued to embrace her aging beauty.
 BrosNYC / BACKGRID "Dear Me, you're getting older. I see lines. Especially when you smile," she wrote on X in 2020. "Every once in a while you consider altering your face, and then you watch a show where you want to see what the person is feeling... and their face doesn't move. I'm cannot get behind it. I just can't."
 Besides, the "Raise Your Glass" singer quipped that she wants Willow, now 15, and son Jameson , 9, "to know what I look like when I'm angry."
 "I've decided that my talent and my individuality is far more important than my face," Pink added. "So get on board cause I am about to AGE THE OL FASHIONED WAY."
 For more celebrities proudly showing off their makeup-free faces, keep reading...
 Instagram / Alyssa Milano Alyssa Milano
 The  Charmed  alum showcased a fresh-faced look  on social media for her 52nd birthday Dec. 19, 2024.
 "This is 52. No make up. No filters. Happiness," Alyssa wrote on Instagram . "Sprinkle that s--t everywhere."
 The actress continued, "I love you all. Even the trolls. If you can hate a stranger—I can love a stranger. So…I love you."
 Alicia Keys / Instagram Alicia Keys
 The OG celebrity to go makeup-free, Alicia shows off her radiant skin.
 Anne Hathaway / Instagram Anne Hathaway
 "I don't think about age," Anne told  Today 's  Sheinelle Jones  in an  interview published September 2023. "To me, aging is another word for living. So, if people want to pay a compliment, it's nice. But whatever the hype is, I'm interested in what's beyond the concept of hype."
 Millie Bobby Brown / Instagram Millie Bobby Brown
 The Stranger Things star shared a makeup-free selfie in 2023, embracing the skin she's in on Instagram.
 Megan Thee Stallion / Instagram Megan Thee Stallion
 The rapper proved that hot girls don't need makeup to look beautiful.
 Pascal Le Segretain/Getty Images Pamela Anderson
 The Baywatch alum is kickstarting a new beauty trend after going makeup-free during Paris Fashion Week . 
 "It's all about self-acceptance," she told i-D magazine on September 2023. "This is the chapter of my life I'm trying to embrace now. Since I really walk out the door as me, I feel relief—a weight off my shoulders."As she put it, "I'm dressing for me now, not for everybody else."
 Drew Barrymore / Instagram Drew Barrymore
 "This is 47!" Drew celebrated in February 2022.

 The Modern Family alum shared a rare makeup-free selfie during Paris Fashion Week 2024.

 The Oscar winner used a VH Skincare sheet mask to refresh her makeup-free face after a long flight in March 2025.

 The Grown-ish actress is known for celebrating her natural beauty and this thirst trap is no different.

 The Rare Beauty founder not only snapped a selfie of her fresh-faced look, but showed off her natural curls.

 The supermodel struck a pose to show off her fresh-faced beauty. "Some take a chill pill," she wrote . "I take a wig break."
 Hailey Bieber
 The model bared it all on TikTok to share her skin condition. 
 "Perioral dermatitis is a skin disorder resembling acne or rosacea," she explained in the text of her video. "In most cases, it involves tiny red bumps that form on the lower half of the face, in the folds of the nose and around the mouth."
 Salma Hayek / Instagram Salma Hayek
 "Thank you for sharing your love, making me feel supported and many times making me laugh," the actress told her followers. "I always learn from all of you and I hope many blessings come your way in this new adventure
 Instagram / Jessica Biel Jessica Biel
 The actress skipped the makeup for a good cause, writing on Instagram, "Spreading some self love today with zero filter and zero makeup for my girl @KateUpton."
 "She's on a mission to encourage everyone to feel strong and love themselves *as they are*... and I'm so honored to help spread that message," Jessica continued. "Take a second to show the real you."

 The actress is often told she doesn't look a day over 21 and this selfie proves it.
